body: Thanks. Bisecting is a bit difficult, since it doesn't seem to happen after a specific time. I'll try with 20 minutes runtime now, didn't happen in 2.12 with that.

Took a while, but the bisect (seemingly) worked:
```
fc57fbae451e425737eb543ffdd8548528853649 is the first bad commit
commit fc57fbae451e425737eb543ffdd8548528853649
Author: Sergei Politov <spolitov@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Apr 2 14:37:14 2022 +0300

    [#11958] DocDB: Split ValueType into KeyEntryType and ValueEntryType

    Summary:
    Currently we use ValueType for both key and value entries.
    But even when value type matches, encoding for value and key are different.
    Also significant part of value types are actual only for value or for key.
    This diff splits ValueType into 2 separate enums - KeyEntryType and ValueEntryType.

    Also key related methods were extracted from PrimitiveValue to KeyEntryValue.

    All codes remains the same, so persistent data is not changed.

    Test Plan: Jenkins

    Reviewers: timur, bogdan

    Reviewed By: timur, bogdan

    Subscribers: ybase

    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.dev.yugabyte.com/D16301
```
When it failed it always failed in under 10 minutes, after 20 minutes I considered a run as good.
@spolitov

Thanks @def-, that was my assumption too, based on the stack pointing to a recently introduced class by @spolitov .
I called that out in Slack as well: https://yugabyte.slack.com/archives/C4K1838GL/p1649264632592889

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-841](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-841)
### Description

This failure happened using the [Long-running System Test](https://github.com/yugabyte/yb-long-system-test/) framework I'm currently working on.

I got this fatal failure in tserver (arcpatch-D16418 code state to prevent crashes from #11993) like this:
```
$ cd ~/code/yugabyte-db
$ bin/yb-ctl --replication_factor 3 create
$ cd ~/code/yb-long-system-test
$ git checkout 43bf4d7 && ./long_system_test.py --runtime=0 --threads=10 --seed=773252 --complexity=full --scenario=cancel_session
[...]
2022-04-07 14:59:11,636 worker_0   ERROR    Unexpected query failure: InternalError_
Query: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE TRUE, VERBOSE FALSE, COSTS TRUE, BUFFERS FALSE, TIMING TRUE, SUMMARY TRUE, FORMAT YAML)
INSERT INTO t4 VALUES ('-25');
  runtime: 2022-04-07 14:59:11.634 - 2022-04-07 14:59:11.635
  supports explain: False
  supports rollback: False
Action: SingleInsertAction
Error class: InternalError_
Error code: XX000
Error message: ERROR:  Illegal state: Attempted to restart when transaction does not require restart
```

[lst_2022-04-07_14:49:47_773252.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/8443004/lst_2022-04-07_14.49.47_773252.zip)
```
2022-04-07 14:59:11,586 worker_0   DELETE FROM t0 WHERE c1_text = '31';
2022-04-07 14:59:11,629 cancel     Canceling worker 0
2022-04-07 14:59:11,634 worker_0   Failed: canceling statement due to user request
2022-04-07 14:59:11,634 worker_0   EXPLAIN (ANALYZE TRUE, VERBOSE FALSE, COSTS TRUE, BUFFERS FALSE, TIMING TRUE, SUMMARY TRUE, FORMAT YAML)
INSERT INTO t4 VALUES ('-25');
```
So it looks like we canceled a query successfully, but in the next query on the same connection we are getting this illegal state internal error.

body:
Checked on previous version, it does not crash. But there are still a lot of corrupted sub doc keys.
So there 2 separate issues:
1) Decoding corrupted sub doc key, that should not happen.
2) Crash on some corrupted sub doc keys. Introduced by fc57fbae451e425737eb543ffdd8548528853649.

I suppose (1) could be backfill related, since this stack could appear only in case of backfill and paginated read.
And long_system_test does a lot of create index/drop index.
We have separate issue for tracking (1): #11992
